hook: Attention replaces recurrence to capture global dependencies instantly.

takeaways.text: Previous models struggled with distant dependencies and parallelization limits.
The Transformer uses only attention to draw global dependencies without recurrence.
It employs stacked self-attention and point-wise layers for both encoder and decoder.
Self-attention connects all positions with constant operations, unlike O(n) recurrent layers.

question: How has this architecture changed your approach to sequence modeling tasks?

rounds.text: Previous models struggled with distant dependencies and parallelization limits.
rounds.reason: The evidence explicitly mentions that sequential nature precludes parallelization and makes it difficult to learn distant dependencies.

rounds.text: The Transformer uses only attention to draw global dependencies without recurrence.
rounds.reason: The evidence states the model eschews recurrence and relies entirely on attention for global dependencies.

rounds.text: It employs stacked self-attention and point-wise layers for both encoder and decoder.
rounds.reason: The evidence confirms the architecture uses stacked self-attention and point-wise, fully connected layers for both encoder and decoder.

rounds.text: Self-attention connects all positions with constant operations, unlike O(n) recurrent layers.
rounds.reason: The evidence explicitly states that self-attention connects all positions with a constant number of operations compared to O(n) for recurrent layers.

rounds.text: The model achieves 28.4 BLEU on German and 41.0 on French at less than one-quarter the cost.
rounds.reason: While the BLEU scores and cost comparison are supported, the evidence only links the 'less than 1/4 training cost' specifically to the French translation task rather than both.
